additional_interpretation.nullspace: A displacement gradient ignores constant translations; symmetric strain also ignores infinitesimal rigid rotations. However u loss and homogeneous support information already constrain these modes in the proposed model. The pending diagnostic determines whether a simple translation contributes materially; it must not be assumed from the gradient gain alone.
